# scripts/Visual/SwingTrail.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../scripts/Visual/SwingTrail.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

A fading ribbon behind a moving blade, the smear a sword leaves in the air.

The owner calls `push(base, tip)` every frame while the blade cuts, with
both points in this node's own space (set `top_level` for world space).
Old samples fade and drop off on their own once pushing stops.

Base: `MeshInstance3D`. Registered class: `none`.
